statement: Fill an enclosed area found from an internal pick point with a pattern, solid, gradient or user-defined pattern, using boundary detection with gap tolerance and island detection.
superiority: Boundary detection is exact with repair preview.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Hatch; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Pick inside a 10x10 square with a circle hole r=2: hatch region area = 100 - pi*4 for Normal island style; gap tolerance 0.05 closes a 0.04 gap.

statement: Define hatch boundaries by selecting closed objects, with island detection off.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Hatch; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Select polyline: hatch fills its interior ignoring inner objects.

statement: Provide ANSI, ISO and custom pattern catalogs (ACAD.PAT, ACADISO.PAT), user-defined patterns (parallel lines, double) and pattern file loading with preview.
superiority: Pattern definitions are open PAT and exact line families; custom patterns importable.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers Hatch; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: ISO pattern ANSI31 draws 45 degree lines at spacing scale*3.175 mm; user-defined spacing 5 angle 30 gives lines at 5 spacing.

statement: Set pattern scale, angle, relative to paper space, and double hatching with ISO pen width.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers HatchScale; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Scale 2 doubles spacing; angle 45 rotates; relative-to-paper-space keeps paper spacing when viewport scale changes.

statement: Set hatch origin by pick, default, bottom left, bottom right, top left, top right, center, store as default.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers HatchBase; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Origin at (1,1): pattern lines positioned relative to that point; patterns repeat across.

statement: Associative hatch updates when boundary changes; non-associative remains; create separate hatches for multiple boundaries.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers UpdateHatches; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Stretch boundary: associative hatch region tracks; delete boundary makes it non-associative with warning (HPASSOC).

statement: Normal, Outer, Ignore styles define how nested boundaries are filled.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Square with two nested squares: Normal fills alternately, Outer only outermost ring, Ignore fills all.

statement: Place hatch behind boundary, back, front, behind or in front of other objects (HPDRAWORDER).
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: HPDRAWORDER 3 puts hatch behind boundary.

statement: One or two color gradients: linear, cylinder, inverse cylinder, spherical, hemispherical, curved, inverted; angle, centered, tint/shade.
superiority: Smooth gradients exported to PDF as shading.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Two color linear gradient at 0 degrees from red to blue: left edge red, right edge blue; centered variant symmetrical.

statement: Fill a region with a solid color or true color, optionally transparent.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Solid hatch area equals region; transparency 50 percent draws semi-transparent.

statement: Set background color for pattern hatches and transparency.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Pattern lines in red with yellow background fill region.

statement: Edit existing hatch: pattern, scale, angle, origin, associativity, boundaries (add, remove, recreate), draw order.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers UpdateHatches; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: HATCHEDIT scale to 3; recreate boundary as polyline produces new boundary object.

statement: Send all hatches to the back of the draw order.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: After HATCHTOBACK hatches are below all other objects in display order.

statement: Create region or polyline boundary from a hatch (Generate Boundary option; HATCHGENERATEBOUNDARY).
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Boundary of a hatch yields closed polyline with same area.

statement: Add or reset boundary or origin of an existing hatch.
notes: Hint only, not credit: cand2 app registers HatchBase; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row. Acceptance sketch: Set new boundary by selected polyline; pattern shifts with origin.

statement: Gap tolerance 0 to 5000 units with auto closing; boundary set from current viewport or selected objects.

source.ref: Hatch gap tolerance and boundary set
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/ (topic: Hatch gap tolerance and boundary set)

notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Gap tolerance 0.5 closes a 0.4 gap and rejects a 0.6 gap; boundary set limits objects considered.

statement: Annotative hatch follows annotation scale.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Hatch annotative scale 1:50 spacing scaled by 50 at plot.

statement: Hatch with many lines remain responsive with limit (MAXHATCH) and fallback to solid when too dense.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: MAXHATCH 1000000: dense hatch displays; too-dense hatch shows as solid with warning.

statement: Create separate hatch objects when selecting multiple boundaries.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: HPSEPARATE 1 creates 3 hatches for 3 boundaries.

statement: Set ISO pen width for ISO patterns to scale pattern.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: ISO 0.5 scales pattern by 0.5 mm line pitch.

statement: Hatch lies on current UCS XY plane; hatch with elevation.
notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: UCS rotated: hatch plane tilted accordingly.

statement: Hatch does not obstruct text with WIPEOUT; exclude text by island detection around mtext.

source.ref: Hatch on tables and dimension display
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/ (topic: Hatch on tables and dimension display)

notes: Hint only, not credit: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry. Acceptance sketch: Hatch with text island leaves hole around text.
